umtify.description:
🎧 UMtify — Music. Style. Experience.

✨ Your Music, Reimagined in Liquid Crystal Glass.

UMtify is a next-generation Android music player that brings online streaming and your personal offline music library together in one seamless experience.

Designed with a sophisticated Material 3 foundation and an immersive Liquid Crystal Glass UI, UMtify combines stunning aesthetics, intelligent personalization, and powerful audio performance — all wrapped in a beautifully fluid interface.
---

✨ Key Highlights

💎 Liquid Crystal Glass UI:
- Premium translucent glass surfaces with elegant visual depth.
- Dynamic themes inspired by album cover artwork.
- Beautifully crafted home-screen widgets and fluid animations.

🎵 Hybrid Music Experience:
- Seamlessly switch between online streaming and local music playback.
- Support for high-quality lossless audio, including FLAC.
- Automatic music folder discovery and offline downloads.

🧠 Smart Personalization
- Time-aware *Smart Mixes* tailored to your listening habits.
- Your Top Artists — a dedicated space for your most-played artists.
- Local → Online Discovery for personalized music recommendations.
- Beautiful, shareable Replay Cards to showcase your listening journey.

🎧 Audiophile-Grade Playback
- Powered by optimized ExoPlayer technology.
- Fast streaming with minimal buffering.
- Spatial Audio and Dolby Atmos support.

⚡ Engineered for Performance
- Smooth scrolling on high-refresh-rate displays.
- Instant tab switching and responsive interactions.
- Optimized loading for a faster, fluid experience.
- A clean, distraction-free interface focused on your music.
---

 🌌 More Than a Music Player

UMtify isn't just about playing music — it's about transforming the way you discover, experience, and enjoy it.

🎶 Elevate Your Listening. Experience UMtify.

UMtify — Music. Style. Experience.
